title: Trampolines and fried eggs
body:
There aren't many vertical travel options, so Trampolines have been added. Craft them from slime, iron and string, and they bounce you upwards when you step on them. Crouch for a smaller bounce.

![image: Trampolines and fried eggs](media/1417730115030220870.png)

![video: Trampolines and fried eggs](media/1417730116699820103.mp4)

Also, eggs can now be cooked into Fried Eggs.

![image: Trampolines and fried eggs](media/1417735161969115197.png)
